column1: # Golden vectors for the shared byte-size and clip-duration labels, read by both shells.
# Nothing links the two, so `MediaClipFormattingVectorTests` (Swift) and
# `MediaClipFormattingVectorTest` (Kotlin) both read this file: a rule edited on one side only fails.
# Sizes are decimal (1 KB = 1000 bytes), with the digits ByteCountFormatter `.file` shows (KB whole,
# MB one place, GB and TB two), rounded half up, trailing zeros dropped and no locale. Durations
# truncate to whole seconds. Zero bytes is an unknown size and renders empty (asserted in code).
